brief_prompt: One small amber air-parcel marker moves left to right over a fixed mountain; cloud thickens during ascent, blue rain peaks only on the left windward slope, then the parcel descends dry on the right.
scene_lock: Locked side-on landscape view of the exact same green mountain, dark foreground, overcast sky, framing and lighting in every supplied frame.
ordered_events: The single amber air-parcel marker moves continuously from the lower left toward the summit while the mountain and camera remain perfectly fixed.
Cloud around that same parcel becomes denser as it rises and cools.
Blue rainfall develops only over the left windward slope and reaches one clear maximum while the parcel crosses the summit.
The same parcel continues down the right leeward side; the blue rainfall fades and does not reappear before the supplied dry endpoint.
invariants: one mountain and one amber parcel marker
mountain geometry, dark foreground, overcast sky, camera, crop and lighting
rain remains on the left windward side
forbidden: a second mountain, building, volcano, lava or snow
rain on the right leeward side
parcel reversal, disappearance, duplication or teleportation
whole-scene crossfade, moving terrain, camera motion or scene change

comparison.L1: one first/last-frame model call using the structured motion contract
comparison.L2: three adjacent first/last-frame calls using accepted keyframes as boundaries
comparison.fallback: all 49 program states rendered through the same accepted appearance route
